Two of Barrichello's teammates from 2000-2025 won a drivers' championship in that period: Michael Schumacher and Jenson Button.

- **Michael Schumacher** was Barrichello's Ferrari teammate in 2000 and 2005 (confirmed by the teammate lookups). Schumacher won the drivers' title in 2000 through 2004.
- **Jenson Button** was Barrichello's teammate at Honda in 2006 and 2008 and at Brawn in 2009 (confirmed). Button won the 2009 drivers' title.
- **Nico Hülkenberg** (Williams, 2010) and **Pastor Maldonado** (Williams, 2011) were teammates but neither won a title.

I did not look up the 2001-2004 and 2007 teammates individually. Barrichello was at Ferrari with Schumacher throughout 2001-2004 and at Honda in 2007, so those seasons are assumed to add no new names.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher, Jenson Button
